name: The traders in the temple
charge: Making the house of prayer a den of thieves
summary: Twice Christ found the temple court full of those that sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting. He made a scourge of small cords, drove them out, poured out the changers' money, overthrew the tables, and would not suffer any man to carry a vessel through the temple.
offense: Isaiah had called it a house of prayer for all people; Jeremiah had asked, is this house become a den of robbers in your eyes? The trade occupied the court of the Gentiles, the only place the nations could pray, and did it, on the gospel's account, for profit under the priests' patronage.
judgment: Driven out with a whip. The chief priests sought how they might destroy him for it. Zechariah's last verse hangs over the scene: in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite, the trafficker, in the house of the Lord of hosts.

entries.commentary: At the marriage in Cana his mother tells him they have no wine, and though he answers, Mine hour is not yet come, she tells the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it. She knew what he could do. The governor of the feast says every man sets forth good wine first, and the worse afterward, but thou hast kept the good wine until now. What was made was better than what had been served. This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.

He made a scourge of small cords and drove them all out of the temple, with the sheep and the oxen, poured out the changers' money and overthrew the tables. He drove grown men out with a whip. Take these things hence; make not my Father's house an house of merchandise. No man had business trading in there at the passover. His disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up. He was fulfilling what David had written.

They ask what sign he shews. Asking after signs was their habit, and the epistle names it. Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up. It went over their heads, and they answered with the forty and six years of building. He spake of the temple of his body. The Most High does not dwell in temples made with hands, and the body itself is called a temple in the scriptures. The saying was kept and used against him later by false witnesses at his trial.
Many believed when they saw the miracles, but he did not commit himself unto them, for he knew all men, and needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.

He rides into Jerusalem on an ass and a colt, and the multitudes spread their garments and branches in the way, crying Hosanna to the son of David. All this was done that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet.

He casts out them that sold and bought in the temple and overthrows the tables of the moneychangers, saying, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.
The chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did and were sore displeased. The works themselves angered them.

The fig tree with leaves and no fruit withers away at his word, and the disciples marvel at how soon it withered. If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and it shall be done.

Asked by what authority he does these things, he asks them first whether the baptism of John was from heaven or of men. They reason among themselves and will not answer, because either answer condemns them, so he does not answer them either.

Of the two sons, the one who said I will not and afterward repented and went is the one that did the will of his father. The publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you. These were teachers of the law who were not doers of it. John came in the way of righteousness and they believed him not, and when they had seen it they repented not afterward that they might believe him.

The householder sends servants for the fruits of his vineyard and they are beaten, killed and stoned; last of all he sends his son, and the husbandmen kill him to seize the inheritance. The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner. This is the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes. Therefore the kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof. The chief priests and Pharisees perceived that he spake of them. --- Topics: [The Feasts of the Most High](/encyclopedia/the-feasts-of-the-most-high) · [The Priesthood](/encyclopedia/the-priesthood)
Two disciples are sent for the colt whereon never man sat, and the multitude spread their garments and branches in the way, crying Hosanna.
Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he finds nothing but leaves, and says, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever.

He casts out them that sold and bought in the temple, overthrows the tables of the moneychangers and the seats of them that sold doves, and will not suffer that any man carry a vessel through the temple. Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves. He did not lead those men out gently. This is not the soft figure preached in the churches; where the law was concerned he acted, and the scribes and chief priests sought how they might destroy him, for they feared him.

The fig tree is dried up from the roots, and the word given is, Have faith in God. Whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and shall not doubt in his heart, he shall have whatsoever he saith. When ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any, that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.

Asked by what authority he does these things, he answers with a question about the baptism of John, and they will not answer it, so neither does he answer them. They came at him again and again, and there was no way to trap him. He was ready in season and out of season.

Keep judgment and do justice, for His salvation is near to come and His righteousness to be revealed. Blessed is the man that does this and lays hold on it, that keeps the Sabbath from polluting it and keeps his hand from doing any evil.

The son of the stranger that has joined himself to the Most High is not to say the Lord has utterly separated him from His people, and the eunuch is not to say he is a dry tree. These strangers spoken of are Israel; the whole passage is the Most High speaking to Israel. To the eunuchs that keep His Sabbaths and take hold of His covenant, He gives a place and a name in His house better than of sons and daughters, an everlasting name that will not be cut off. The sons of the stranger that join themselves to Him, keep the Sabbath, and take hold of His covenant, He will bring to His holy mountain and make joyful in His house of prayer; their offerings will be accepted, for His house will be called a house of prayer for all people. The Lord God who gathers the outcasts of Israel says He will yet gather others to Him besides those already gathered.

All the beasts of the field and forest are called to devour. Judgment is turned on the failed leadership. The watchmen are blind and ignorant, dumb dogs that cannot bark, sleeping and loving to slumber. They are greedy dogs that never have enough, shepherds that cannot understand. They all look to their own way, every one for his gain, saying they will fetch wine and fill themselves with strong drink, and tomorrow will be as this day and much more abundant.

The word came to Jeremiah to stand in the gate of the Lord's house and proclaim to all Judah that enter in to worship. Amend your ways and your doings and He will cause you to dwell in this place, which ties back to how our iniquities turn away the good things, for as long as we keep the law He will bless us.

Trust not in lying words, saying, The temple of the Lord, the temple of the Lord, as though the building itself would save them. If they truly amend their ways, execute judgment between a man and his neighbor, oppress not the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, shed not innocent blood, and walk not after other gods, then He will let them dwell in the land He gave their fathers.

They trust in lying words that cannot profit while they steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, and burn incense unto Baal. They walk after other gods and then come and stand before Him in the house called by His name, saying they are delivered to do all these abominations; has this house become a den of robbers in their eyes.

Go now to Shiloh where He first set His name and see what He did to it for the wickedness of His people Israel; we cannot always blame the other nations, for we did these things while still in our own land. Because they did all these works and He spoke to them rising up early, but they heard not, and He called but they answered not.

Therefore He will do to this house, called by His name and trusted in, as He did to Shiloh. He will cast them out of His sight as He cast out their brethren, the whole seed of Ephraim, the northern kingdom.

Pray not for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer nor make intercession, for He will not hear. The children gather wood, the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead their dough to make cakes to the queen of heaven and pour out drink offerings to other gods to provoke Him to anger.

Do they provoke Him to anger, or do they not rather provoke themselves to the confusion of their own faces. His anger and fury shall be poured out upon this place, upon man and beast, the trees and the fruit, and it shall burn and not be quenched.

Put your burnt offerings unto your sacrifices and eat flesh, for He spoke not to their fathers concerning burnt offerings when He brought them out of Egypt. This one thing He commanded them: obey My voice, and I will be your God and ye shall be My people, and walk in all the ways He commanded, that it may be well with them.

They hearkened not nor inclined their ear but walked in the counsels and imagination of their evil heart and went backward, not forward. He sent all His servants the prophets daily, rising up early, yet they hearkened not, hardened their neck, and did worse than their fathers.

The Most High tells Jeremiah he shall speak all these words to them, but they will not hearken, and call to them, but they will not answer. This is a nation that obeyeth not His voice nor receiveth correction; truth is perished and cut off from their mouth.

Cut off thine hair, O Jerusalem, and take up a lamentation, for the Most High has rejected and forsaken the generation of His wrath. The children of Judah set their abominations in the house called by His name and built the high places of Tophet to burn their sons and daughters in the fire, which points to the abortions of today, a thing He never commanded.

The days come when it shall be called the valley of slaughter, for they shall bury in Tophet till there is no more room. The carcasses shall be meat for the fowls and beasts with none to fray them away, and He will cause to cease the voice of mirth, gladness, the bridegroom, and the bride, for the land shall be desolate. --- Topics: [Idolatry](/encyclopedia/idolatry) · [Sacrifice and Atonement](/encyclopedia/sacrifice-and-atonement) · [The Priesthood](/encyclopedia/the-priesthood)

Behold, the day of the Lord cometh, and thy spoil shall be divided in the midst of thee. I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city shall be taken, and the houses rifled, and half of the city shall go forth into captivity, and the residue of the people shall not be cut off from the city. Then shall the Lord go forth, and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle. His feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives, and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west, and there shall be a very great valley. Ye shall flee to the valley of the mountains, like as ye fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah: and the Lord my God shall come, and all the saints with thee.

It shall come to pass in that day, that the light shall not be clear, nor dark: but it shall be one day which shall be known to the Lord, not day, nor night: but it shall come to pass, that at evening time it shall be light. Living waters shall go out from Jerusalem; half of them toward the former sea, and half of them toward the hinder sea: in summer and in winter shall it be. The Lord shall be king over all the earth: in that day shall there be one Lord, and his name one. All the land shall be turned as a plain; and it shall be lifted up, and inhabited in her place; and men shall dwell in it, and there shall be no more utter destruction; but Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited.

This shall be the plague wherewith the Lord will smite all the people that have fought against Jerusalem; their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, and their eyes shall consume away in their holes, and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth. A great tumult from the Lord shall be among them; and they shall lay hold every one on the hand of his neighbour, and his hand shall rise up against the hand of his neighbour. Judah also shall fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the heathen round about shall be gathered together, gold, and silver, and apparel, in great abundance.

Every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, and to keep the feast of tabernacles. Whoso will not come up of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, even upon them shall be no rain. This shall be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all nations that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles. In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses, HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD; and every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holiness unto the Lord of hosts. In that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of the Lord of hosts. --- Topics: [Clean and Unclean Meats](/encyclopedia/clean-and-unclean-meats) · [Idolatry](/encyclopedia/idolatry) · [The Feasts of the Most High](/encyclopedia/the-feasts-of-the-most-high)

Save me, O God, for the waters are come in unto my soul; I sink in deep mire where there is no standing, come into deep waters where the floods overflow me. I am weary of my crying, my throat is dry, my eyes fail while I wait for my God. They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head.
O God, Thou knowest my foolishness, and my sins are not hid from Thee. Nothing is hid from God. Whether it be good or evil, He brings every secret thing into judgment. -

Let not them that wait on Thee be ashamed for my sake, nor those that seek Thee be confounded, O God of Israel. For Thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face. I am become a stranger unto my brethren and an alien unto my mother's children, for the zeal of Thine house hath eaten me up. The scripture says blessed are you when they hate you, mistreat you, and speak evil of you. We should look at going through these conditions and know that according to the scriptures we are blessed. It may not look like it, but this is one of the ways you know you are on the right track, because the world hates what we teach because they love their evil deeds.

When I wept and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach; I made sackcloth my garment and became a proverb to them. Just like it says in [Deuteronomy 28](/bible/deuteronomy/28), this is how it feels to be under the curses, to be a proverb and an astonishment and a byword. David was like, Lord, I am a king, this is not supposed to be happening. They that sit in the gate speak against me, and I was the song of the drunkards.

But my prayer is unto Thee, O Lord, in an acceptable time; in the multitude of Thy mercy hear me, in the truth of Thy salvation. We may think the Lord does not hear us. That is why in the fullness of time God sent His son. In the Christian church they say He may not come when you want Him, but He is always on time; the Lord comes in an acceptable time. Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink; let me be delivered from them that hate me and out of the deep waters. Deliver me from the haters, and let not the deep swallow me up.

Hear me, O Lord, for Thy lovingkindness is good; turn unto me according to the multitude of Thy tender mercies, and hide not Thy face from Thy servant, for I am in trouble. When we call on God we want Him to hear us. It is not pleasant to call on God and have Him tell you, as in [Hosea 5:15](/bible/hosea/5#v15), that He will return to His place till you acknowledge your offense. Hear me speedily; draw nigh unto my soul and redeem it; deliver me because of mine enemies. -

Thou hast known my reproach, my shame, and my dishonour; mine adversaries are all before Thee. Reproach hath broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. Do not give yourself to heaviness, because heaviness and sorrow have killed many people. Through faith and comfort of the scriptures you will have hope, because in this walk you look to this person and that person for comfort and find none. We have to deliver our own soul by our own righteousness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none, and for comforters, but I found none. They gave me gall for my meat, and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink. This goes into Christ.

Let their table become a snare before them, and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap. You can read about this in Isaiah 28: the word became precept upon precept and became a snare and a trap unto them, and they went backwards, because we bring out the understanding of the Bible but people do not want to hear it. You think you are a Christian and good with God going to church every Sunday, but it does not work like that. Let their eyes be darkened that they see not.

Pour out Thine indignation upon them, and let Thy wrathful anger take hold of them; let their habitation be desolate. This is why blindness happened to the southern Kingdom leadership that forsook Christ; their eyes were darkened and their table became a snare. You read about all this in [Romans 11](/bible/romans/11). Add iniquity unto their iniquity, and let them not come into Thy righteousness; let them be blotted out of the book of the living and not be written with the righteous. That is a heavy statement. -

But I am poor and sorrowful; let Thy salvation, O God, set me up on high. I will praise the name of God with a song and magnify Him with thanksgiving. This shall please the Lord better than an ox or bullock, because He loves obedience more than sacrifice. The humble shall see this and be glad, for the Lord heareth the poor and despiseth not His prisoners.

Let the heaven and earth praise Him, the seas and everything that moveth therein. When you read the Three Holy Children, all the creation praises God. For God will save Zion and will build the cities of Judah, that they may dwell there and have it in possession. Only the oppressed need to be saved, and that is us. The seed of His servants shall inherit it, and they that love His name shall dwell therein. Those that keep the commandments are going to dwell there. -

verses.text: And the Jews’ passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,
And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:
And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers’ money, and overthrew the tables;
And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father’s house an house of merchandise.
And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.
And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,
And said unto them, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.

And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;
And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.
And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.
And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.

Even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people.
Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen it, saith the Lord.

Yea, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holiness unto the Lord of hosts: and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them, and seethe therein: and in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of the Lord of hosts.
For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.

lawsResolved.text: True worship and service to God requires not formalism or excessive piety but to do justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with God.
Priests are to keep the charge of the sanctuary and tabernacle of the congregation and keep it supplied and in proper order.
Corruption is the way of those who are greedy of gain.
You shall not bring the hire of a harlot or the wages of a dog (male prostitute) into the house of the LORD your God for any pledge, vow or tithe.
